name: Vanguard-Class Soldier Robot
senses: linked senses 60 feet, x-ray vision (precise) 60 feet

perception.note: Darkvision, linked senses 60 feet, x-ray vision (precise) 60 feet

items.name: Integrated Advanced Painglaive
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

This fierce but deceptively elegant polearm rips apart enemies with a motor-powered fangblade. An adjustable pulse trigger allows the wielder to channel extra pain through the weapon.

items.name: Integrated Advanced Seeker Rifle
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

This single-shot sniper rifle is one of the most popular weapons in the Vast thanks to its stability and reliability with minimal upkeep.

offensiveAbilities.name: Assault Jump
offensiveAbilities.description: The vanguard-class soldier robot Leaps to a space it can see within 60 feet. All creatures within 5 feet of where the robot lands must succeed at a DC 33 Reflex Saving Throw save or be knocked Prone. The robot then makes a painglaive Strike against one creature within reach. The robot can't use Assault Jump again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Linked Senses (60 feet)
offensiveAbilities.description: The vanguard-class soldier robot shares senses with other allied vanguard-class soldier robots within 60 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Seeker Warhead
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The vanguard-class soldier robot fires a plasma warhead at an intersection within 200 feet it can see. All creatures in a 15ft Type:burst take 8d12 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 33 Reflex Saving Throw save). On a failure, a creature is also Dazzled and Deafened for 1 minute. The area in which the warhead exploded becomes difficult terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: X-Ray Vision (60 feet)
offensiveAbilities.description: The vanguard-class soldier robot can see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Its sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of metal, or any amount of lead or starmetal, and it can see only in black and white.
